From: chris.foster@enron.com
To: coganja@aol.com
Date: 2001-01-25
Subject: Nominations for February

John:

Space on EP to Nogales out of Permian Keystone or Waha is not available.  It 
might become available in early Feb. We can watch it and look for a good day 
to do this.  If it absolutely needs to happen in Jan we might be able to do a 
flow day diversion from the SoCal border but that will add a significant 
amount to the price as it would cost SoCAl Border plus.  Can we wait?

C


   
	Enron Capital & Trade Resources Corp.
	
	From:  CoganJA@aol.com                           01/25/2001 10:29 AM
	

To: Chris.H.Foster@enron.com
cc: sbreen@czn.com, cwlipke@czn.com

3,000 Dth to Nogales #3 (Power Plant) under Citizens' El Paso interruptible
